ui.privacy_purpose: Purpose of processing: The information you provide in this questionnaire (including health data) is used exclusively to prepare and carry out your traffic medicine (fitness-to-drive) examination.
ui.privacy_legal: Legal basis: Your consent (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. a, Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. a DSGVO – GDPR). You may withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.
ui.privacy_storage: Storage: The result is added to your examination records and is subject to the medical retention periods. Online access via your personal link expires at the end of its validity; the data of this online questionnaire is then routinely deleted.
ui.privacy_rights: Your rights: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data protection supervisory authority.
ui.privacy_secrecy: All information is subject to medical confidentiality.

exam_occasion.label: For which driving licence is the examination taking place?

options.fahrgast: Passenger transport (taxi, chauffeured hire car, patient transport)

exam_kind.label: Is this a first issue or a renewal?

license_classes.label: Which driving licence categories do you hold or are you applying for?

license_years.label: For how many years have you held a driving licence?

driving_hours.label: On average, how many hours do you drive per day?

night_driving.label: Do you regularly drive at night?

accidents.label: Have you had any accidents or near-accidents in road traffic in the last 24 months?

license_withdrawn.label: Has your driving licence ever been withdrawn, or have you ever had to take part in a medical-psychological assessment (MPU)?

psych_test_done.label: Have you already completed a psychological performance test (reaction, concentration and attention test) for this driving licence?
psych_test_done.hint: For bus categories and passenger transport, this proof is required under Anlage 5 FeV (Annex 5 of the German Driving Licence Regulation). Please bring any existing report to the examination.
psych_test_done.followup: When and where was the test carried out?

has_conditions.label: Do you have a known pre-existing medical condition, a permanent physical impairment, or are you receiving regular medical treatment?
has_conditions.hint: This also includes serious illnesses further back in the past (e.g. heart, diabetes, nerves, mental health). If no, the questionnaire becomes considerably shorter.

seizure_ever.label: Have you ever had an epileptic seizure or convulsion?
seizure_ever.followup: When was the last seizure, how many have you had in total, and was there a trigger (e.g. lack of sleep, fever, alcohol)?

epilepsy.label: Have you been diagnosed with epilepsy?
epilepsy.followup: Do the seizures occur exclusively during sleep? Are you under regular neurological care?

seizure_free.label: How long have you now been free of seizures?
seizure_free.hint: The guidelines link fitness to drive to specific seizure-free periods.

antiepileptics.label: Do you take medication against seizures (antiepileptic drugs)?

options.reduktion: The treatment is currently being reduced step by step

syncope.label: Have you ever suddenly fainted (brief loss of consciousness)?

syncope_recent.label: Was your last fainting episode less than 6 months ago?
syncope_recent.followup: In what situation did the fainting occur, and was a cause found (e.g. circulation, heart rhythm, while urinating)?

syncope_prodromi.label: Do you get warning signs before fainting (e.g. sweating, dizziness, nausea, palpitations)?

glasses.label: Do you wear glasses or contact lenses when driving?

eye_disease.label: Do you have a known eye disease (e.g. cataract, glaucoma, retinal disease, restricted visual field)?
eye_disease.followup: Which disease, and are you under the care of an eye specialist?

one_eyed.label: Do you see clearly worse with one eye, or are you blind in one eye?

night_vision.label: Do you have problems seeing at dusk or in the dark, or are you strongly dazzled by oncoming traffic?
night_vision.followup: In which situations do the problems occur?

hearing_impaired.label: Do you have severe hearing loss, or are you deaf?
hearing_impaired.followup: Since when, and are you under the care of an ear, nose and throat (ENT) doctor?

hearing_aid.label: Do you wear a hearing aid or cochlear implant?

heart_disease.label: Do you have a known heart or vascular disease?
heart_disease.hint: e.g. rhythm disorders, heart attack, heart failure, valve defects, circulatory disorders
heart_disease.followup: Which disease(s), since when, and how are they treated?

cardio_checkup.label: Are you having regular check-ups with a cardiologist because of this?

heart_attack.label: Have you ever had a heart attack, a stent procedure or bypass surgery?
heart_attack.followup: When was the event or procedure, and were there complications (e.g. reduced pumping function)?

arrhythmia.label: Do you have known heart rhythm disorders (e.g. skipped heartbeats, racing heart, noticeably slow pulse, atrial fibrillation, AV block)?
arrhythmia.followup: What diagnosis, and how is it treated?

pacemaker_icd.label: Do you have a pacemaker or defibrillator (ICD)?
pacemaker_icd.followup: When was it implanted, and when was the last check-up?

icd_shock.label: Has your defibrillator delivered a shock in the last 3 months?
icd_shock.followup: When, and what did your cardiologist say about it?

exertion_symptoms.label: During exertion, do you get shortness of breath, chest pain, skipped heartbeats or unusual exhaustion?
exertion_symptoms.hint: Self-assessment according to the NYHA stages

options.keine: No, no symptoms during everyday exertion
options.stark: During heavier exertion (e.g. climbing stairs briskly)
options.leicht: Even during light exertion (e.g. walking slowly)

hypertension.label: Do you have known high blood pressure?
hypertension.followup: Since when, which medication, and what readings do you usually measure?

bp_dizziness.label: While taking your blood pressure medication, do you experience dizziness, feelings of weakness or your vision going black?

heart_other.label: Do you have another known heart or vascular disease: heart valve defect, congenital heart defect, heart muscle disease (cardiomyopathy), inherited rhythm disorder (e.g. long QT), aortic aneurysm or narrowed carotid artery?
heart_other.followup: What diagnosis, and how is it monitored/treated?

family_sudden_death.label: Has there been a sudden cardiac death in your immediate family (parents, siblings, children)?

stroke.label: Have you ever had a stroke, a brain haemorrhage or a TIA (temporary circulatory disturbance with short-lasting deficits)?
stroke.followup: When was the event, and was rehabilitation completed?

stroke_residuals.label: Do you still have after-effects such as paralysis, speech disorders, memory problems or a restricted field of vision?
stroke_residuals.followup: Which symptoms do you still have at present?

head_injury.label: Have you ever had a severe head injury (with loss of consciousness or a hospital stay) or an operation on the brain?

head_injury_recent.label: Was this injury or operation less than 3 months ago?
head_injury_recent.hint: According to the guideline, after a brain injury or brain operation there is generally no fitness to drive for 3 months.

brain_residuals.label: Since the injury/operation, do you have complaints such as concentration or memory problems, personality change or seizures?
brain_residuals.followup: Which complaints, and how do they affect you?

parkinson.label: Have you been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease or another movement or coordination disorder?
parkinson.followup: Since when, how is it treated, and when was the last neurological check-up?

ms_spinal.label: Do you have known multiple sclerosis, a spinal cord disease or a spinal cord injury?
ms_spinal.followup: What diagnosis, and what complaints do you currently have?

muscle_nerve.label: Do you have a known muscle or nerve disease (e.g. muscle wasting, myasthenia, polyneuropathy)?
muscle_nerve.followup: What diagnosis, and how severely are you limited?

paralysis_attacks.label: Do you experience attack-like paralysis or sudden severe muscle weakness?
paralysis_attacks.followup: When did the last attack occur, and how quickly does it set in?

motor_limits.label: Do you have paralysis, muscle weakness or sensory disturbances in your arms or legs that could limit you when operating a vehicle?
motor_limits.followup: Which parts of the body are affected?

vertigo.label: Do you suffer from dizziness or balance disorders (e.g. spinning sensation, swaying, unsteadiness when walking)?
vertigo.followup: What does the dizziness feel like, how often does it occur, how long does an attack last, and what triggers it?

vertigo_last.label: How long ago was your last dizziness attack?

vertigo_prodromi.label: Do your dizziness attacks announce themselves in advance (e.g. ear pressure, ear noises, reduced hearing), so that you could stop in time?

vertigo_positional.label: Is the dizziness triggered by certain head movements or changes of position (e.g. turning over in bed, bending down)?

vertigo_ear.label: Does the dizziness occur together with reduced hearing, ear noises (tinnitus) or a feeling of pressure in the ear?

ear_disease.label: Have you been diagnosed with a disease of the balance organ or inner ear (e.g. positional vertigo, Ménière's disease)?
ear_disease.followup: What diagnosis, how was it treated, and have you been free of symptoms since then?

mobility_limits.label: Do you have a permanent restriction of the mobility of your arms, legs, hands or spine (e.g. after an accident, operation, amputation)?
mobility_limits.followup: Which parts of the body are affected, and since when?

prosthesis.label: Do you wear a prosthesis or use orthopaedic aids?
prosthesis.followup: Which aids, and do you have complaints during longer strain?

vehicle_modified.label: Has your vehicle been modified because of a physical limitation (e.g. hand controls, steering aid)?
vehicle_modified.followup: Which modifications, and are they entered in your driving licence?

diabetes_type.label: Do you have known diabetes mellitus (high blood sugar disease)?

diabetes_therapy.label: How is your diabetes currently treated?

options.tabl_low: Tablets with a low risk of hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar) (e.g. metformin)
options.tabl_high: Tablets with a risk of hypoglycaemia (sulfonylureas, glinides)

hypoglycemia.label: In the last 12 months, have you had a severe hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar) in which you needed help from another person?
hypoglycemia.followup: How often, when was the last episode, and did it occur while awake or during sleep?

hypo_awareness.label: Has it happened that you did not notice a low blood sugar in time yourself (missing warning signs)?
hypo_awareness.followup: When was the last time, and was anything done about it (e.g. training, change of therapy)?

glucose_monitoring.label: Do you regularly measure your blood sugar yourself (or do you wear a glucose sensor)?

options.2x: Yes, at least twice a day
options.keine_med: Does not apply to me (no blood-sugar-lowering medication)

diabetes_derailment.label: In the last few months, has your therapy been newly adjusted, or has your metabolism gone off track (e.g. hospital treatment because of derailed blood sugar values)?

kidney_disease.label: Do you have a known chronic kidney disease or reduced kidney function?
kidney_disease.followup: Which disease, and are you being treated by a kidney specialist (nephrologist)?

dialysis.label: Are you regularly treated with dialysis (blood washing)?
dialysis.followup: Since when, and how often per week? Do you feel fit between the treatments?

transplant.label: Have you had an organ transplant (e.g. kidney, heart, liver, lung)?
transplant.followup: Which organ, when, and are you in regular follow-up care?

lung_disease.label: Do you suffer from a chronic lung or bronchial disease (e.g. COPD, asthma, pulmonary fibrosis)?
lung_disease.followup: Which disease, and how is it treated?

dyspnea.label: Do you have shortness of breath even during light exertion or at rest, or do you need long-term oxygen therapy?

cough_syncope.label: During severe coughing fits, have you ever experienced dizziness, your vision going black or brief loss of consciousness?

daytime_sleepiness.label: Do you find it hard to stay awake and attentive during the day – especially in monotonous situations (e.g. reading, meetings, longer car journeys)?

microsleep.label: In the last few months, have you fallen asleep unintentionally or had episodes of microsleep (nodding off for seconds)?
microsleep.followup: In which situations? Has it also happened at the wheel?

snoring.label: Have you been told that you snore loudly and irregularly or have pauses in breathing at night?

osas.label: Have you been diagnosed with a sleep apnoea syndrome (pauses in breathing during the night)?
osas.followup: When was the diagnosis made, and what severity or AHI value was found (if known)?

cpap.label: Are you being treated for the sleep apnoea (e.g. CPAP breathing mask)?

psychiatric.label: Have you been diagnosed with a mental illness (e.g. depression, anxiety disorder, bipolar disorder)?
psychiatric.followup: Which illness, and how is it treated?

psychiatric_severe.label: Have you ever been treated in hospital for this, had a manic phase or thoughts of taking your own life?

psychosis.label: Have you ever been diagnosed with schizophrenia or another psychosis (an illness with delusions or hallucinations)?
psychosis.followup: How many acute episodes have you had, when was the last one, and are you under specialist care?

memory_problems.label: Have you yourself or your relatives recently noticed increasing memory or orientation problems in you?
memory_problems.followup: Since when, and how do they affect everyday life?

concentration.label: Do you have concentration or attention problems?

alcohol.label: How often do you drink alcohol?

alcohol_control.label: Has it happened that you drank more than intended or lost control over your consumption?

alcohol_traffic.label: Have you ever come to attention in road traffic under the influence of alcohol (e.g. drink-driving, fine, MPU)?
alcohol_traffic.followup: When, and what blood alcohol level was found (if known)?

alcohol_dependence.label: Have you ever been diagnosed with alcohol dependence, or have you undergone detoxification or withdrawal treatment?
alcohol_dependence.followup: When was the treatment completed, and since when have you been abstinent?

drugs.label: Do you currently take drugs (e.g. cannabis, cocaine, amphetamines), or did you regularly use drugs in the past?
drugs.followup: Which substances, how often, and when was the last time?

cannabis.label: How often do you use cannabis?

substitution.label: Are you receiving substitution treatment (e.g. methadone)?

sedating_meds.label: Do these include medications that can make you tired or affect your ability to react (e.g. strong painkillers/opioids, sleeping pills or sedatives, antidepressants, antiepileptic drugs, allergy medication)?

med_side_effects.label: Do you notice side effects from your medication such as tiredness, slowing down, concentration problems or dizziness?
med_side_effects.followup: Which side effects, and how severe?

med_recent_change.label: In the last few weeks, has such a medication been newly started, or has the dose been changed significantly?

benzo_regular.label: Have you been regularly taking sleeping pills or sedatives (e.g. benzodiazepines) for several months – even only in the evening in small amounts?
benzo_regular.followup: Which medication, for how long, and do you notice withdrawal symptoms when you leave it out?

multiple_conditions.label: Do you have several diseases or health impairments at the same time?
multiple_conditions.hint: Several findings can, taken together, be relevant for fitness to drive, even if each one alone would be harmless (guidelines, chapter 2.7).
multiple_conditions.followup: Please briefly list all known diseases.

other_conditions.label: Are there any other diseases, complaints or previous operations that have not been mentioned so far?

driving_adaptation.label: Because of health limitations, do you deliberately avoid certain journeys (e.g. in the dark, long distances, motorway)?

consent_truth.label: I confirm that my answers are complete and truthful.
consent_truth.error: Please confirm that your information is complete.

consent_privacy.label: I have read the privacy notice and consent to the processing of my data for traffic medicine purposes.

ess_items.ess_3: Sitting inactive in a public place (e.g. a theatre or a meeting)
ess_items.ess_4: As a passenger in a car for an hour without a break
ess_items.ess_5: Lying down to rest in the afternoon
ess_items.ess_8: In a car, as the driver, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic
